leads.claim: A movie projectionist reported seeing a landed flying saucer and four small creatures with oversized heads and delicate legs.
leads.why: The claim is a secondhand report of a sighting and alleged encounter, lacking any evidence of government custody or physical material.
leads.quote: he suddenly sighted four creatures about three and one-half feet in height

leads.claim: A technician assigned to Sandia Air Force Base allegedly flew in a saucer from the base to New York City in 30 minutes.
leads.why: This is an unsubstantiated claim of an event involving a contractor employee, with no mention of physical material or government verification.
leads.quote: HE CLAIMS ONE JOHN FRY, A TECHNICIAN NOW ASSIGNED TO SANDIA AF BASE, NEW MEXICO, HAS ACTUALLY FLOWN IN A SAUCER

doc_verdict: This document contains no evidence of the government or contractors obtaining, holding, or analyzing physical UAP material; it consists entirely of administrative records, sighting reports, and unsubstantiated claims.
